probe.scope: named service process only; excludes child-process CPU

collector.scope: named service process only; excludes child-process CPU

model.scope: named service process only; excludes child-process CPU

gateway.scope: named service process only; excludes child-process CPU

upstream.scope: named service process only; excludes child-process CPU

agent.scope: named service process only; excludes child-process CPU

workload_cgroup.scope: all constrained model/gateway/tool/agent descendants; includes service work in interval

event_to_attestation_latency.scope: signed clock-anchor event time to collector attestation; includes queue/transport/signing; not isolated collector processing

limitations: No matched unobserved task baseline; CPU consumption is not causal task overhead.
RSS/memory peaks cover service lifetime, including initialization; CPU deltas cover only declared interval.
Archive rate covers all captured host events, not independently complete workload ground truth.
Latency is estimated from held signed clocks; uncertainty/negative samples remain visible.

reconciliation_cli_wall_time_ms.scope: controller wall time including CLI process startup and all verification work; not isolated reconciler CPU
